# Branches that are promised the FULL battery, not merely a trigger.
# One name per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# `ci-trigger-branches.txt` answers "does any workflow start for a pull
# request into this branch". This file answers the harder question: "does
# every job that runs for the branch above it in the stack also run here".
# The two are different, and the difference was measured on 2026-11-27.
#
# What was measured. A pull request into `consensus-of-consensuses` produced
# 112 check runs. The pull request one step below it in the same stack, into
# `testnet-50`, produced 106 - and eight of the jobs it did show were
# `skipped`: the binary SBOM + CVE audit, dead deps, binary size, taplo, the
# Kani bond proofs, udeps, geiger and the semver gate. The cause is a
# job-level `contains(fromJSON('["main","consensus-of-consensuses"]'),
# github.event.pull_request.base.ref)`: in a stacked pull request GitHub
# evaluates the `branches:` filter against the root of the stack, so the
# workflow starts, and the job-level condition then sees the immediate base
# and skips. GitHub reports a skipped job as a passing check and `testnet-50`
# requires no status check at all, so the delivery branch looked gated and
# was not.
#
# The rule this file enforces (gate `ci-full-battery-parity`, tests in
# `xtask/gates/tests/full_battery_parity.rs`): for every name below, every
# job-level base-ref allowlist in `.github/workflows` must admit it, and every
# workflow that carries such an allowlist must also name it in its
# `pull_request:` trigger. Fail-closed: a name here that a job skips is a
# failure, not a note.
#
# Adding a name here is a cost decision: it runs the heavy battery (Kani,
# udeps, geiger, auditable, semver) on every pull request into that branch.
# Add a branch when a pull request actually targets it as a delivery base, and
# take it out again when that pull request has landed. A branch that is only a
# merge waypoint belongs in `ci-trigger-branches.txt` and not here.

# The live delivery chain, 2026-11-27: #221 (slice -> testnet-50) and
# #215 (testnet-50 -> consensus-of-consensuses).
main
consensus-of-consensuses
testnet-50
